info.title: operator-orchestration-service API
info.summary: Bounded workflow broker API for idea intake and Workspace Delivery ART execution.
info.description:
Canonical API reference for the currently implemented operator-orchestration-service route surface. Workflow meaning stays in the repo operator docs; this spec is the route and payload reference layer.

## Reading This Front
- `/v1/...` routes are broker-shaped contracts, not raw OpenProject passthroughs.
- Most write routes carry mutable fields inside an `input` object.
- Idea capture and bounded idea decisions also carry an `operator` object so the broker can attribute the human action.
- Broker-shaped ids look like `idea-40`, `delivery-38`, and `work-item-177`.
- Caller-authenticated routes require both `x-oos-caller-id` and `x-oos-caller-secret`.

get.description: Use this to confirm the broker process is alive. This does not prove downstream dependencies such as OpenProject are reachable.

200.description: Runtime is live.

get.description: Use this to confirm the broker is ready to serve workflow traffic. Unlike `/healthz`, this reflects dependency readiness checks.

200.description: Runtime is ready.

get.description: Returns static broker identity and caller-auth mode so an operator can confirm which runtime is serving the current lane.

200.description: Static runtime version metadata.

get.description: Lists the broker's own workflow catalog. Use this when an adapter or operator surface needs the canonical workflow ids, summaries, and supported capabilities without scanning repo docs.

200.description: Broker workflow catalog.

get.description: Reads one canonical broker workflow descriptor. Use this before building an adapter, documenting a route family, or proving which status vocabulary a workflow supports.

200.description: Workflow descriptor for one broker workflow family.

get.description: Returns a bounded broker projection of idea records. Use query filters to page through canonical idea state without pulling raw OpenProject work-package fields.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum ideas to return. Defaults to 10 and is capped at 25.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional canonical idea lifecycle status filter.

200.description: Bounded broker list projection for ideas.

get.description: Reads one canonical broker idea projection by broker-shaped id such as `idea-40`.

200.description: Canonical broker read projection for one idea.

post.summary: Lookup an idea by source identity
post.description: Resolves an existing canonical idea record from a source identity. Use this when a source adapter already has a conversation or message reference and needs to check whether the broker has already captured it.

requestBody.description: Send either a normalized `source` object or a surface token plus `source_ref`. The full object form is clearer for new integrations.

200.description: The broker found the canonical idea mapped to the supplied source identity.

post.description: Creates or reuses the canonical durable idea record for new source-adapter input. Use this as the first durable write when an idea should leave chat context and enter the broker-owned backlog.

requestBody.description: Provide the human operator identity, the normalized source reference, and the durable idea title. `body` is optional but should contain the supporting context worth preserving.

captureTelegramIdea.summary: Capture an idea coming from Telegram

value.body: One of the most common triggers for new ideas is discussion with Codex.
value.title: Need a durable place to store deferred ideas

200.description: The broker captured or reused the canonical idea record.

post.description: Records the operator-authored framing for a captured idea before any durable decision is made. Use this to summarize why the idea matters, who likely owns it, or what must happen next.

requestBody.description: Fill `input.summary` with the durable triage framing you want preserved on the idea record. Include the operator so the broker can attribute who made the triage call.

input.summary: Needs a bounded broker workflow before later decision handling.

200.description: Triage framing was recorded.

post.summary: Record the first bounded durable idea outcome
post.description: Records the first durable decision on a triaged idea. Use this to move the idea into `parked`, `accepted`, or `rejected` together with operator-authored decision notes.

requestBody.description: Set `input.status` to one of `parked`, `accepted`, or `rejected`, and explain the decision in `input.notes`.

parkIdea.summary: Park an idea with durable notes

input.notes: Revisit this after the owner-assigned vocabulary lands.

200.description: The bounded durable idea outcome was recorded.

post.summary: Consume an accepted idea into Workspace Delivery ART
post.description: Internal-only broker route. Use this only after an idea is already accepted and ready to become a delivery initiative. This is not a source-adapter chat command surface.

requestBody.description: Optionally set `input.target_pi` when the accepted idea should land inside a specific PI at creation time.

consumeAcceptedIdea.summary: Consume an accepted idea into PI-2026-02

200.description: The broker linked the accepted idea to a delivery initiative.

post.description: Internal-only broker route. Use this only after the linked delivery work is complete. The broker verifies delivery closeout before moving the source idea to `implemented`.

requestBody.description: Provide the durable closeout note that explains how the idea was actually delivered.

input.closeout_notes: Delivered through the first bounded execution slice.

200.description: The broker closed out the source idea against the linked delivery outcome.

post.description: Internal-only broker route. This stores bounded evaluation metadata such as suspected owner, scope, trust-boundary areas, and AI lane assessment. It is not an operator-facing chat command.

requestBody.description: Fill the bounded evaluation fields you want preserved on the idea. Use canonical repo, scope, trust-boundary, confidence, and AI-lane tokens rather than free-form vocabularies.

input.notes: Broker owns the workflow contract and Telegram is a thin adapter.

200.description: Evaluation metadata was recorded.

get.description: Lists bounded broker projections of delivery initiatives. Use this to inspect the current initiative inventory without reading raw OpenProject epic fields.

200.description: Broker list projection for delivery initiatives.

get.description: Returns the current execution slice for one initiative, including filtered child work items. Use this for runtime status, not planning intent.

200.description: Bounded execution summary for one initiative.

get.summary: Read planning summary for one initiative
get.description: Returns the broker planning view for one initiative. Use this to decide the next active front, remaining ready work, and whether parked or done items should be considered.

200.description: Bounded planning summary for one initiative.

get.summary: Read PI objective slice for one initiative
get.description: Returns PI-objective-focused records for one initiative. Use it when you need the PI slice rather than the entire initiative execution tree.

200.description: PI objective slice for one initiative.

get.summary: Read closeout readiness for one initiative
get.description: Checks whether the initiative is actually closeout-ready. Use this before attempting initiative completion so open descendants and weak evidence are visible first.

200.description: Closeout readiness projection for one initiative.

post.description: Updates bounded initiative-level governance fields without changing the child plan. Use it for epic status, PM2 phase, sponsor, success criteria, or governance evidence fields.

requestBody.description: Send only the initiative governance fields you need to change. At least one field inside `input` must be present.

input.system_demo_evidence: Broker governance route proved in devint.

200.description: Governance update applied to the initiative epic.

post.description: Applies a bounded plan beneath one initiative and reconciles it against existing child work items. Use this when the desired child plan is known and should be created, reused, updated, or retired deliberately.

requestBody.description: Provide the desired bounded child plan in `input.plan`, plus optional reconciliation decisions for missing or retired items.

reconcileDeliveryPlan.summary: Apply a bounded child plan with explicit reconcile decisions

items.subject: Enabler: Brokerize delivery initiative governance update

items.description: Broker route owns the operator plan path.
items.subject: Enabler: Brokerize delivery plan apply and reconciliation

200.description: Bounded plan reconciliation result.

post.description: Records system-demo evidence against one initiative. Use this for durable demo summary, evidence, date, follow-up, and outcome capture at the initiative level.

requestBody.description: Fill the durable system-demo summary and evidence. Optional date, outcome, and follow-up fields let you keep the initiative record self-explanatory.

recordSystemDemo.summary: Record demo evidence after a proof run

input.demo_evidence: Direct broker closeout path proved in devint.
input.demo_summary: System demo confirmed the bounded operator route works end-to-end.

200.description: System demo evidence was recorded.

post.description: Records inspect-and-adapt findings for one initiative. Use this to preserve the retrospective summary and concrete action items that should influence the next execution slice.

requestBody.description: Provide the inspect-and-adapt summary and the concrete action items. Optional date and follow-up fields help anchor when the learning was captured.

input.action_items: Land the guard before any more parent closeout.
input.inspect_follow_up: Treat the ART guardrail gap as a workflow control defect.
input.inspect_summary: Parent closeout must fail closed until all child work is actually complete.

200.description: Inspect-and-adapt evidence was recorded.

post.description: Records PI review outcomes and actual business values for the initiative's objective slice. Use this when PI review evidence needs to be written back to the broker-owned ART records.

requestBody.description: Set the review date and PI when helpful, then provide one or more bounded review records with the target work package id, review outcome, and actual business value.

recordPiReview.summary: Record PI review outcomes for one objective slice

reviews.review_note: Direct broker closeout is now the canonical path.

200.description: PI review outcomes were recorded.

post.description: Creates one child work item below an existing parent. Use this for bounded ART planning when a single new task, enabler, or objective should be added with governance fields in the same write.

requestBody.description: Fill `input.parent_work_item_id`, `input.type`, and `input.subject` at minimum. Add PI, assignment, delivery-team, iteration, and DoR/DoD fields when the new item should be ready immediately.

createChildTask.summary: Create a ready child task beneath an active feature

input.acceptance_criteria: - Operator can create one child task through the broker.
input.definition_of_ready: - Parent feature and PI are already active.
input.subject: Brokerize delivery work-item move

200.description: Delivery work item was created below the supplied parent.

post.description: Applies the same bounded update surface to multiple work items in one request. Use this when a small coordinated set of items needs status, assignment, or governance changes together.

requestBody.description: Provide `input.schema_version=1` and one or more update entries. Each entry must include the target work package id plus at least one bounded update field.

bulkAdvanceTwoItems.summary: Advance two work items into execution together

updates.work_note: Started the first broker cutover slice.

200.description: Bulk update results.

get.summary: Read continuation context for one work item
get.description: Returns the compact continuation packet for one work item. Use this before continuing ART work so parent chain, open siblings, and previously completed related items are visible first.

200.description: Compact continuation packet for one ART work item.

post.description: Updates one existing work item through the broker-owned bounded field surface. Use this for status, PI, assignee, work-note, readiness, and governance-field changes without moving or completing the item.

requestBody.description: Provide at least one mutable field inside `input`. Use the `clear_*` booleans only when you intend to remove an existing value rather than replace it.

startWorkItem.summary: Assign and start a work item

200.description: Bounded update result for one work item.

post.summary: Move one work item under a new parent
post.description: Reparents one work item beneath a different parent. Use this when planning changed and the current work item belongs under another feature or objective.

requestBody.description: Set the new parent broker id in `input.new_parent_work_item_id`. Optionally leave a durable `work_note` explaining why the move happened.

moveToNewParent.summary: Move a task under a different feature

input.work_note: Move proof is running through the broker route.

200.description: Move result for one work item.

post.summary: Set or clear blocker governance on one work item
post.description: Sets, clears, or resolves blocker governance for one work item. Use this when execution must record the blocker statement, impact, owners, review date, and decision path in a bounded form.

requestBody.description: Set `input.action` first, then provide the blocker fields that match that action. For `set`, capture the blocker statement, impact, owners, dates, and decision path explicitly.

setBlocker.summary: Record a blocker on a work item

input.blocker_impact: Execution proof cannot continue until the blocker workflow is broker-owned.
input.blocker_justification: Lift the existing blocker semantics behind the broker before continuing.
input.blocker_statement: Current blocker workflow still depends on the platform-side runner.

200.description: Blocker governance result for one work item.

post.summary: Set or clear one dependency relation
post.description: Sets, updates, or clears one dependency relation for a target work item. Use it to preserve dependency edges, lag, and supporting notes through the broker rather than editing OpenProject relations directly.

requestBody.description: Provide `input.action` and the broker id of the upstream item in `input.depends_on_work_item_id`. Optional lag and description let you preserve why the dependency exists.

input.description: Dependency proof through the broker route.

200.description: Dependency management result for one work item.

post.summary: Park, retire, or resume one work item
post.description: Parks, retires, or resumes one work item through the bounded broker parking surface. Use it when work should leave the active front or re-enter it with an explicit decision and reason.

requestBody.description: Set `input.action` to the parking action you need, then provide the decision, reason, review date, or resume target fields that make that action self-explanatory.

parkWorkItem.summary: Park a work item with a defer decision

input.park_reason: Hold this task outside active scope until the next slice starts.
input.work_note: Parking proof is running through the broker route.

200.description: Parking or resume result for one work item.

post.summary: Complete one work item with evidence
post.description: Completes one work item only when the broker-formatted evidence sections are supplied. Use this after the local work is validated and committed so the ART record shows what changed and what proved completion.

requestBody.description: Fill the required completion sections exactly as evidence prose, not ad hoc fragments. `changed_surfaces`, `test_result_evidence`, and `validation_evidence` should already be operator-readable when posted.

completeWithEvidence.summary: Complete a work item with formatted evidence

input.completion_note: Local-only completion on branch `codex/api-docs-redoc-front` at commit `a6e3676`.
input.completion_summary: Deepened the API front so each route now explains what it does and shows concrete request examples.
